livingCosts.notes: Monash Malaysia's own cost-of-living pages (monash.edu.my/student-life/international/cost-of-living) return HTTP 403 to automated access and no archive copy was reachable, so this is a secondary, Malaysia-wide 2026 student budget from a student-housing provider, midpoints of its ranges: housing = accommodation RM300-1,500 (900) + electricity/water RM50-200 (125) + internet RM50-100 (75); food = 'comfortable lifestyle' RM700-1,000 (850); transport = public transport RM50-200 (125); personal = RM200-500 (350) + mobile plan RM30-80 (55). Its overall guide is RM1,500 (basic) to RM2,000-2,500 (comfortable) a month.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering (Honours)
programmes.notes: International fee RM54,915 per year (Malaysian students RM48,101) as listed on StudyMalaysia.com's '2026 Fees & Requirements' page for the course. Secondary source: monash.edu.my returns HTTP 403 to automated access and no archive copy was reachable. StudyMalaysia does not say whether the 6% service tax on international students' fees or the registration/general-amenities fees are included; none added. Monash Malaysia reviews fees annually, so not cohort-locked. No published 2024/2025 figure was found, so no fee history.
